scope: Six Morpho Blue routes, including the exact-empty callback boundary for supply, repay, and supplyCollateral, on the canonical Ethereum and Base deployments admitted by PQ1

abi.source: Exact borrow, withdraw, withdrawCollateral, supply, repay, and supplyCollateral entries selected from the v1.0.0 forge artifact ABI

build.relationship: Masking exactly the two forge-reported DOMAIN_SEPARATOR immutable references to zero makes each deployed runtime byte-identical to this official v1.0.0 build. No other deployed byte differs.

evidence: Both fixed-block runtimes match the official v1.0.0 build outside the two compiler-declared immutable references.
Both independent RPC operators per chain returned zero for the standard EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots.
The only cross-chain runtime differences are the two repeated chain-specific DOMAIN_SEPARATOR immutable words.
direct_contract_classification.boundary: The standard-slot checks alone do not exclude every bespoke proxy. Exact build/runtime equality carries the direct-code classification.

routes.name: borrow
routes.semantics: Exactly one of assets and shares must be zero. Asset mode mints borrow shares rounded up for the exact signed loan-token assets; share mode derives loan-token assets rounded down from the exact signed shares. The authorized onBehalf position incurs the debt and receiver receives the resulting loan-token assets.
routes.residual: Accrued market totals, authorization state, oracle price, health, liquidity, and share conversion are live state. The display shows both signed input words and does not predict the derived output.

routes.name: withdraw
routes.semantics: Exactly one of assets and shares must be zero. Asset mode burns supply shares rounded up for the exact signed loan-token assets; share mode derives loan-token assets rounded down from the exact signed shares. The authorized onBehalf supply position is reduced and receiver receives the resulting loan-token assets.
routes.residual: Accrued market totals, authorization state, liquidity, and share conversion are live state. The display shows both signed input words and does not predict the derived output.

routes.name: withdrawCollateral
routes.semantics: The exact nonzero signed assets amount is subtracted from the authorized onBehalf collateral position and the exact collateral-token amount is transferred to receiver after the resulting position passes the health check.
routes.residual: Authorization state, accrued interest, oracle price, and post-withdraw health are live state. The display does not claim success.

routes.name: supply
routes.semantics: Exactly one of assets and shares must be zero. Asset mode mints supply shares rounded down for the exact signed loan-token assets; share mode derives loan-token assets rounded up from the exact signed shares. The resulting supply shares are credited to onBehalf and the loan-token assets are transferred from the caller.
routes.residual: Accrued market totals, allowance, token behavior, and share conversion are live state. The display shows both signed input words and does not predict the derived output. Admission additionally requires the exact-empty callback condition below.

routes.name: repay
routes.semantics: Exactly one of assets and shares must be zero. Asset mode burns borrow shares rounded down for the exact signed loan-token assets; share mode derives loan-token assets rounded up from the exact signed shares. The onBehalf debt position is reduced and the loan-token assets are transferred from the caller.
routes.residual: Accrued market totals, allowance, token behavior, outstanding debt, and share conversion are live state. The display shows both signed input words and does not predict the derived output. Admission additionally requires the exact-empty callback condition below.

routes.name: supplyCollateral
routes.semantics: The exact nonzero signed assets amount is added to the onBehalf collateral position and the exact collateral-token amount is transferred from the caller.
routes.residual: Allowance, token behavior, market existence, and transaction success remain live state. Admission additionally requires the exact-empty callback condition below.

callback_policy.admitted_condition: data is the sole canonical dynamic bytes tail, its length word is exactly zero, and its padded end is exactly calldata EOF
callback_policy.refusal: Any non-empty callback payload, aliased or misaligned offset, trailing bytes, or otherwise malformed ABI encoding refuses before signing pages.

boundary: Historical fixed-block and source evidence only. It grants no live-state, future-code, production, shipment, fallback, or blind-signing authority.
